info.title: Greek Developer - YouTube CLI
info.description: Upload a video to YouTube from the command line - set title, description and visibility, or schedule publication. Non-interactive by design, so an AI agent can drive it.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: youtube: publish a video to YouTube. Non-interactive, so an agent can drive it.

options.name: --Json
options.description: Write the result to stdout as a single JSON object [default: False]

commands.name: upload
commands.description: Upload a video to the authorized channel

options.name: --File
options.description: The video file, named as an option instead

options.name: --Category
options.description: Category name or numeric id. Defaults to People & Blogs

options.name: --Visibility
options.description: Public, Unlisted or Private. Defaults to Private

options.name: --PublishAt
options.description: ISO 8601 timestamp to publish at. Implies private until then

options.name: --ForKids
options.description: true or false. Defaults to false

options.name: --Tags
options.description: Comma-separated search keywords, max 500 characters in total

options.name: --DryRun
options.description: Report what would be uploaded and exit, without contacting YouTube [default: False]

arguments.name: VIDEOFILE
arguments.description: The video file to upload. Metadata is read from the .md file beside it

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the channel's videos, with their status and lifetime counts

options.name: --Scheduled
options.description: Only videos with a publication date still pending, soonest first [default: False]

options.name: --Limit
options.description: How many to report. Defaults to 25; 0 means all [default: 25]

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Manage this machine's authorization for a channel

commands.name: login
commands.description: Grant access to a channel. Opens a browser - the one command that needs a human

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report whether a usable authorization exists, and for which channel

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Discard the stored authorization on this machine. Does not revoke it at Google

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the version, commit and build time of this build

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Print this tool's agent guide, ready to save as a skill file
